sentences.en: Type inference has three outputs whereas checking only has two.
sentences.zh: 类型推论有三个输出，而检查只有两个。

sentences.en: In certain situations, inferences are needed.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，需要进行推断。

sentences.en: Based on his behavior, I made an inference that he was feeling unwell.
sentences.zh: 根据他的行为，我推断他身体不舒服。

senses.zh: 推论, 推理, 推断 - 推断结果, 结论
